mechanism.claim: At cryptocurrency quarter-hour openings, concentrated algorithmic activity makes the completed first-five-minute aggressive quote imbalance informative. When its absolute imbalance is causally strong and trailing BTC realized variation is elevated, follow the imbalance direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed quarter-hour opening aggressive quote imbalance
mechanism.why_distinct: Existing fixed eight-hour flow candidates aggregate long blocks or compare halves; hour-of-week candidates use calendar means; trade-arrival candidates ignore quarter-hour phase. HVQHOFR uses 96 daily quarter-hour openings, a completed five-minute flow window, causal strength and volatility ranks, and an onset/reservation clock, without fitted returns, prior events, or promoted controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: trailing completed 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: entry minutes :10/:25/:40/:55 and quarter-hour onset reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.opening_window: five exact completed BTCUSDT one-minute rows [A,A+5m)
features.trailing_variation: sqrt(sum squared log(close/open) over 1,440 exact completed one-minute rows [A-24h,A)), finite strict positive
features.prior_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 2,688 earlier source-valid quarter windows, minimum 1,920, current excluded
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid quarter window ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: paper-supported quarter-hour periodic order-flow predictability with fixed causal ranks

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no quarter phase, opening window, rank history, strength, variation, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.paper: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
external_basis.authors: Chan Kim and Peter Reinhard Hansen
external_basis.reported_horizon: opening order imbalance forecasts four-to-twelve-hour futures returns
external_basis.selection_use: mechanism and fixed eight-hour horizon only; no repository incidence or outcome opened
